what_to_detect: A token on the battlefield whose characteristics are exactly those its creating effect defined: no mana cost, and no supertype, rules text or ability the effect did not give it.
near_miss: A token whose creating effect defines an ability (a keyword or a line), which the token then has.

what_to_detect: A token whose creating effect gives it no name, named its subtype(s) plus the word Token.
near_miss: A token whose creating effect names it, carrying that name and not its subtypes plus Token.

what_to_detect: A static ability changes a token's subtypes (a types contribution on a token entity) and the token keeps the name it was created with.
near_miss: A token with no types contribution, whose name and subtypes are those it was created with.

what_to_detect: A token-making resolution (or a token copy of an instant or sorcery card) that produces no token_created event because a rule or effect forbids the token's characteristics on the battlefield.
near_miss: A token-making resolution of the same API that creates its token.

what_to_detect: A static ability that affects permanents, or permanents of a card type or subtype, contributes to a token entity as it does to a card.
near_miss: A static ability on the same board contributes nothing to a token whose types it does not select.

what_to_detect: A token's zone_change out of the battlefield, after which the token is absent from every zone in the next snapshot.
near_miss: A card's zone_change out of the battlefield, which stays in the destination zone.

what_to_detect: A token moved to hand, library or exile that is absent from every zone afterwards.
near_miss: A card moved to the same zone, which stays there.

what_to_detect: A token that left the battlefield and, under a flicker or return effect, yields no zone_change back to the battlefield.
near_miss: A card under the same effect returning to the battlefield.

what_to_detect: A token-making resolution creates a Treasure token whose characteristics are the predefined ones: a colorless Treasure artifact with '{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color'.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API that creates no Treasure token (no token, or a token of another kind).

what_to_detect: The ability a Food token's predefined definition gives it resolves from the token's line: its controller gains 3 life and the token is sacrificed.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Food token's ability.
record_fields: record.ability (acting line's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

what_to_detect: A token-making resolution creates a Gold token whose characteristics are the predefined ones: a colorless Gold artifact with 'Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color'.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API that creates no Gold token (no token, or a token of another kind).

what_to_detect: A Walker token in the record's snapshot carries the predefined characteristics: a 2/2 black Zombie creature token named Walker.
near_miss: A token of another kind, which carries none of the Walker definition.

what_to_detect: The ability a Shard token's predefined definition gives it resolves from the token's line: its controller scries 1, then draws a card, and the token is sacrificed.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Shard token's ability.
record_fields: record.ability (acting line's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

what_to_detect: The ability a Clue token's predefined definition gives it resolves from the token's line: its controller draws a card and the token is sacrificed.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Clue token's ability.
record_fields: record.ability (acting line's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

what_to_detect: The ability a Blood token's predefined definition gives it resolves from the token's line: its controller, having discarded a card as a cost, draws a card and the token is sacrificed.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Blood token's ability.
record_fields: record.ability (acting line's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

what_to_detect: A nonartifact spell candidate is not affordable because the {C} a Powerstone token adds can't be spent on it.
near_miss: An artifact spell candidate counts the Powerstone's {C} and is affordable.

what_to_detect: A Incubator token in the record's snapshot carries the predefined characteristics: front face a colorless Incubator artifact with '{2}: Transform this token'; back face a 0/0 colorless Phyrexian artifact creature named Phyrexian Token.
near_miss: A token of another kind, which carries none of the Incubator definition.

what_to_detect: The static ability of a Cursed Role token (a colorless Aura Role enchantment token) contributes to the creature it enchants: base power and toughness 1/1.
near_miss: A static of another source contributing the same field, or a Role token of another kind.
record_fields: record.ability (acting static's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

record_fields: record.ability (acting static's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Young Hero token's ability.

what_to_detect: A Junk token's ability candidate fails its timing check outside its controller's main phase with an empty stack (activate only as a sorcery).
near_miss: The same Junk token ability candidate passes its timing check in a main phase with an empty stack.

what_to_detect: The ability a Lander token's predefined definition gives it resolves from the token's line: a basic land card moves from its controller's library to the battlefield tapped and the token is sacrificed.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Lander token's ability.
record_fields: record.ability (acting line's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

near_miss: A resolution of the same API from a line that is not a Mutagen token's ability.
record_fields: record.ability (acting line's script file, a tokenscripts entry)

what_to_detect: A token-making resolution creates a Vibranium token whose characteristics are the predefined ones: a colorless Vibranium artifact with indestructible and '{T}: Add {C}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell'.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API that creates no Vibranium token (no token, or a token of another kind).

what_to_detect: A red or green spell candidate is affordable by counting the {R} or {G} a Heartwood token adds.
near_miss: A spell candidate needing a colour other than red or green, which the Heartwood token's mana cannot pay, is not affordable.

what_to_detect: A token created by name alone, the name not a predefined token kind, carries the characteristics of the Oracle card of that name (its mana cost, types, colours, P/T and abilities).
near_miss: A token whose creating effect defines its characteristics, which carries only those.

what_to_detect: A resolution instructed to create a token copy of an object that does not exist produces no token_created event.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API whose copied object exists (or is known by last known information) creates the token copy.

what_to_detect: A permanent-spell copy resolving onto the battlefield as a token with no token_created event.
near_miss: A created token (token_created) from a Token-API resolution.
